findings.title: Inline dotted named-note ids bypass the heterogeneous note inventory
findings.java_mechanism: CommandFactoryNote accepts the valid inline `note "text" as memo.v1` declaration; CommandLinkElement then reuses the existing quark through getDummy.
findings.rust_mechanism: RE_NOTE_FLOATING at deployment.rs:469-472 only permits `\w+`, whereas RE_NOTE_FLOATING_MULTI permits `[\w.]+`. The inline declaration is skipped, then the changed resolver cannot find it and creates a normal DeploymentNode from the relation.
findings.evidence: checker_dotted_code_destination.puml and its Java SVG, Rust SVG, and Rust AST
findings.impact: This violates the claimed one-note/one-identity invariant, changes source order and entity UIDs, and produces a node-shaped replacement rather than the declared note. It is not an Opale visual residue.

findings.title: Quoted endpoint labels do not follow Java quark resolution
findings.java_mechanism: CommandLinkElement cleanId/quarkInContext resolves `"Service Label"` as an independent endpoint code, so the link materializes Service Label separately from the node declared with alias ServiceAlias.
findings.rust_mechanism: resolve_connection_endpoint falls through to resolve_id, which matches DeploymentNode.label and rewrites `Service Label` to ServiceAlias before identity lookup.
findings.evidence: checker_quoted_node_label_and_note.puml and its Java SVG, Rust SVG, and Rust AST
findings.impact: The relation endpoint is silently changed and the Java third entity is absent. This is an endpoint-resolution failure on a valid named-note relation.

findings.title: The mechanism handles the simple heterogeneous-identity cluster
findings.evidence: The seven passing probes cover multiline dotted ids, directed and reverse-directed shafts, both endpoint sides, nested ownership, declaration ordering, multiple links, and Deployment note-to-note links. XML validation passed for all 18 generated SVGs.
findings.notes: For exactly-one note-to-non-note cases, Java's GraphvizImageBuilder.isOpalisable/onlyOneLink moves the edge into EntityImageNote and suppresses normal link metadata. The account declares this rendering difference as separate residue; it was not used as a rejecting finding.

anti_overfit_audit.evidence: The implementation diff adds only namespace resolution, note SVEK ids, and entity-map registration. Searches found no fixture label, checker input, include_str!, or golden-data reference in the changed parser/renderer paths.

required_follow_up: Do not accept this mechanism. Port one coherent named-note code and endpoint grammar from the Java quark model, including inline dotted ids and quoted endpoint code semantics, then rerun this preserved corpus with a new independent checker.
